featured_reviews.name: Vivek More
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Fun Fiesta Multiplex and had an absolutely wonderful experience! 🎬 The vibrant and energetic atmosphere immediately put me in a great mood. From the moment I walked in, the staff were friendly and efficient, making the whole process of getting tickets and snacks a breeze. The cinema itself was fantastic – comfortable seating, crystal-clear picture quality, and excellent sound truly enhanced the movie-watching experience. I particularly enjoyed the wide selection of refreshments available. It's truly a top-notch entertainment venue that I would enthusiastically recommend to anyone looking for a fun outing with friends or family. I'm already planning my next visit! ✨🍿😊🎉

featured_reviews.name: Prem Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This movie theatre is located very close to the area, making it a highly convenient option for regular visits. One of the best things about this place is that it feels quite pocket-friendly, especially when compared to some of the bigger multiplex chains. However, it’s always a good idea to compare the pricing and features with PVR before making a final decision, particularly if looking for a more premium movie experience.

The seating arrangement here is surprisingly good for the price point. The regular seats offer decent comfort and support throughout the movie. That said, the sofa seats are not really worth the extra money – they don't add significant value in terms of comfort or luxury, so it's better to stick with the standard seating options.

The staff at this theatre are well-behaved and helpful. Their treatment of visitors is polite and respectful. One standout feature is their on-seat food service, which is quick and makes the experience more enjoyable.

The theatre is located in Nalasopara, making it a great choice for locals. Both the screen quality and sound system exceed expectations for this price range. For a budget-friendly yet satisfying cinematic experience, this theatre is definitely worth considering.

Lot of people were saying that food is very much expensive (that's why many times i avoid eating in theatres, either you have coke and popcorn in theatres or in the same amount you can have complete lunch or dinner in a decent restaurant)

featured_reviews.review_text: This multiplex stands out as one of the finest cinema destinations in the entire Mira Bhayandar, Vasai Virar area. The sheer size and quality of the screen elevate every film to a new level, ensuring that each viewing is nothing short of spectacular. The vibrant visuals, coupled with immersive sound, make it a must-visit for any movie enthusiast. I am certain that watching a movie here will be an unforgettable experience, leaving you eager to return for more.

featured_reviews.name: Rouque Nation
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Cinema in Virar

Absolutely terrible experience at Rockstar Cinema, Virar.

Right from the entrance, there was no proper security. Instead of trained staff, a little girl was casually asking for tickets, which felt completely unprofessional and unsafe.

As soon as we entered the cinema hall area, there was a horrible stench—like a rotten rat had died somewhere. When we informed the staff, instead of fixing the issue, they just sprayed some air freshener, which made it even worse.

I had booked an M Gold ticket, but the seat was broken. I had to adjust uncomfortably throughout the movie because no staff member was willing to help or even bother.

During the National Anthem, there was no sound at all. People just stood up and sat down in silence, completely ruining the experience and showing zero respect for the moment.

The food counter was equally disappointing—nothing was available. No samosa, no water, no cold drinks, no popcorn. The only thing they had was stale nachos with oily mayonnaise, which looked completely inedible.

Overall, a very disappointing and frustrating experience. Poor management, lack of basic facilities, and no concern for customers. Definitely not visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: Priya Dutta
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Fun Fiesta Mall Theatre offers a mixed experience – not outstanding, but not too bad either. It’s the kind of place you might visit once in a while, especially if you're nearby.
One of the better aspects is the top floor of the mall, where the theatre is located. The ambience here is surprisingly good, with several spots that are great for clicking pictures. If you're looking for a casual hangout with friends or family, the top floor makes for a nice setting.

Overall, Fun Fiesta Mall Theatre isn't the best in town, but it’s not the worst either. If you're nearby and looking for a quick movie plan with some chill vibes, it’s worth considering.

featured_reviews.name: Naresh Save
featured_reviews.review_text: This hall and marriage ground is located near Chakreshwar Talav on Sopare Gaon Road from Nalasopare Western Railway Station. The share auto is available from the station and the present charge is Rs.10/- per person.You have to get down at the specific stop - Dhananjay Talkies Stop and from there its a 4 minutes walk on village rough road on right side. The hall is beautifully decorated with nice paintings and decorative lamps. The stage is at appropriate height and the chairs are arranged in ascending order just like in a theatre. The capacity of Hall is around 300 persons and is the most suitable for marriage, birthday, anniversary, gettogether, thread ceremony, kitty, etc. parties. The ground is very beautiful with big high coconut trees and you get a wonderful panoramic  view of sunset from this place. The staff at the Hall are very courteous and of helping nature and always smiling while tendering service. There is however much scope for improvement and some renovation with minor repairs is required so as to improve cleanliness. The hall is suitable mostly for local people from Nala and Sopare and nearby villages as the Charges for hiring the same are reasonable and the place is conveniently located for them who can come there with their owned private vehicles or autos. The hall is also approachable from Chakreshwar Talav side by entry near a Masjid. There is ample space for parking of vehicles. Overall the Hall satisfies the needs of the nearby villages for their marriage, birthday, etc. ceremonies.

featured_reviews.name: Lalita
featured_reviews.review_text:
Capital Mall, Vasai was honestly my go-to place for shopping while I was in Vasai, mainly because there aren’t too many other good shopping or hangout options nearby. While it’s definitely smaller compared to many malls in Mumbai/Delhi, it still manages to offer a decent overall experience and is a great addition to the area.

In terms of shopping, there are a few prominent brands available—for example, The Body Shop, which is a nice find here. From the collection and variety point of view, I felt Pantaloons had the best range, especially when it comes to clothing options. Zudio clearly has the highest footfall; the pricing and collection are quite good and enjoyable for casual shopping.

Apart from shopping, there’s also a gaming zone, which adds to the entertainment options. The mall has PVR for movies—it gives the mall a premium touch. I personally never ended up watching a movie here, but it’s definitely a big plus and makes the mall feel more complete.

The food court was the main highlight for me. It genuinely doesn’t disappoint. You have good pizza chains, quick meal options like Box8 (Desi Meals), plus donuts, chai, and a few other snack/dessert/meal varieties. There’s enough choice for everyone, and it’s a great place to relax after shopping.
We celebrated Women’s day and birthdays here.

One downside though—getting autos/cabs in the evening is very difficult; fares are extremely high. It’s better to drive your own vehicle if you’re planning to visit, especially later in the day.

Overall, despite being a smaller mall, Capital Mall is a great addition to Vasai and serves as a solid shopping + food + entertainment destination.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are glad that you appreciate our offerings, we constantly strive to enhance your experience! We hope to see you again at Capital!

featured_reviews.name: Bhumi Chitroda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Capital Mall Review

Capital Mall is a well-designed and lively shopping destination that offers a complete experience for shopping, food, and entertainment. The mall has a modern layout with spacious corridors, good lighting, and a clean, well-maintained environment, making it comfortable to explore even during peak hours.

It features a good mix of branded stores, local outlets, and daily-use shops, so there’s something for every budget. Fashion, accessories, electronics, and lifestyle stores are neatly organized, making shopping easy and enjoyable. The food court is another highlight, offering a variety of options ranging from fast food to casual dining, perfect for families, friends, and office-goers.

Capital Mall is also a great place for entertainment, with options like a cinema and kids’ play areas, making it suitable for all age groups. Security arrangements are proper, and facilities like parking, elevators, and restrooms are well managed.

Overall, Capital Mall is more than just a shopping place—it’s a complete hangout spot where you can shop, eat, relax, and spend quality time. Whether you’re visiting for a quick purchase or a full day outing, Capital Mall provides a pleasant and convenient experience worth visiting again.

featured_reviews.review_text: I visited Shree Prastha Ground during the "I Love Nalasopara Utsav" and had a great experience! It’s a spacious and well-maintained ground, perfect for big events. featured_reviews.name: Lokesh Bogati
featured_reviews.review_text:
Here's my detailed review

Location is accessible from nearest railway station by autorickshaw.

This is one of the oldest locality of Nalasopara. The towers built are good and with enough space and facilities.

The road is stretched long with a garden, theatre, many eateries on the way.

If you're planning move here do consider certain things like accessibility during rain season as the area fills up a lot with water. Other than that the area offers to be filled with crowd and still spacious enough.

featured_reviews.name: The Uncommon Man . Sugarman
featured_reviews.review_text: It was supposed to be an affordable housing complex but regrettably it didn't work.  Today it's an area with individual housing societies.... It has come a long way from being a secluded area to a busy habitable colony. There are Many shops and markets in the vicinity which provides ample daily supplies. Was pleasently surprised to see developments all around Sri prasth. A good place for affordable homes even today .
